description: This file defines the Mail entity class used for managing email data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as recipient lists, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type, along with getter and setter methods. The class is mapped to the database table 'ohrm_mail_queue' using Doctrine ORM annotations and implements the Mail interface from the system's core mailing component.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing a mail message, including recipient lists, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type, with ORM mappings for database persistence.
